scope: Law of Root October 13, 2025; common rules, four base factions, Fall/Winter, base Vagabond characters, dominance and coalitions; exclude expansion content, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.

authoritative_sources_read: Complete applicable common/base sections 1-9.6 in extracted/root-rules.txt and PDF pages 2-10
C.1 component inventories, applicable G definitions, M.1-M.2 and V.1-V.3, cross-checked in PDF
independence.method: Read source procedures first and compare each actual request and its key. Do not count unrequested contextual key material as coverage. Recognize glossary terms used by requested procedures without manufacturing a terminology-only question for every definition.

findings.detail: All eighty question IDs have one matching key in the same order. All eighty keys agree with the applicable October 13, 2025 Law. No further material source error or missing requested procedural branch identified.

The recorded new Q07 entry exactly equals the active v9 entry. It explicitly removes the four dominance cards, shuffles the shared deck, then draws three-card hands. This completes the existing broad standard-setup/deck request and needs no additional question. Old/new records differ only by this correction; other-version immutability claims were not tested by opening prohibited historical files.

Core common actions, costs, timing and consequences, Standard Setup, each base faction phase/action, Fall/Winter, base characters, dominance and coalition procedures have actual requested coverage. For example ordinary Alliance Recruit relies on explicit Q78, Vagabond Daylight permission on Q79, Strike payment on Q80, crafted-item destination on Q71 and crafting-piece identity/question-mark icon on Q72. Merely finding these facts in another answer was not credited.

There are exactly 52 accepted expansion IDs and eight disjoint retained-overlap IDs covering Q21-Q80, with no missing or repeated IDs. Each accepted question has at least one new operative facet; partial overlap elsewhere in that question is not counted again. Q56 is supported by immediate face-up crafted-item acquisition/use, not repeated-pawn or hammer-cost claims.

Recorded passes 24 and 25 are consecutive, each with zero additions and no correction/reclassification. Pass23 is explicitly excluded. Fresh independent common/setup and faction/map/character sweeps found no further qualifying addition or key correction. This validates their stopping conclusion against the current evidence, not an unobservable reconstruction of the earlier reviewers work.
